title: Avery Styles Is Coming To GCW, Trey Miguel Cleared To Return, & More - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
31 minutes ago
Avery Styles is set for the next step in his young wrestling career.
GameChanger Wrestling (GCW) has announced that the son of AJ Styles will make his GCW debut during the promotion’s July 31 event in Omaha, NE. Avery is also scheduled to compete the following night on August 1, although GCW has not yet revealed his opponents for either appearance.
The announcement comes just weeks after Avery stepped into the ring for the first time. He made his in-ring debut on June 26 for Squared Circle Action in Georgia, facing Ashton Martin in a singles match.
Following the debut, AJ Styles couldn’t hide how impressed he was with his son’s performance. He said,
“To see them do so well in a main event, I was blown away. If you have seen my first match, terrible. These guys did really well, and I’m so impressed with everything they’ve done. To see them put together that match and execute it so well, blown away. It was a simple story, told the way it should have, without so much involved that you couldn’t follow it. A lot of times, you put too much crap in one bag and try to fit it all, and you can’t. As fans, we can’t digest everything going on because there is so much going on. It was just enough of what they needed to see. As far as his debut, for him to pull off the springboard off the guardrail, little things like that, the timing, beautiful.”
TNA Wrestling could soon be getting one of its top stars back.

After being sidelined with a fractured patella suffered during his TNA International Championship match against Mustafa Ali at TNA Rebellion, Trey Miguel has announced that he has officially been cleared to return to in-ring action.
Taking to Twitter, Miguel shared the positive update with fans, writing,
“Cats out the bag, I’m officially Cleared 💚”
While the announcement confirms that Miguel is medically cleared, TNA has not revealed when he will make his official return to television.
Persephone is set to put the CMLL World Women’s Championship on the line against Tessa Blanchard later this month.
The title match was made official during the July 8 edition of CMLL Informa after reigning champion Persephone answered Blanchard’s challenge. The two will now meet for the championship on July 31 in what will be one of Persephone’s biggest title defenses to date.
Persephone has held the CMLL World Women’s Championship since March, when she defeated Mercedes Mone to win the title. Since capturing the gold, she has successfully defended it three times and will now look to add another successful defense against Blanchard.
